COD.rationale: Content (red) and its origin/status are both explicitly given for the same referent/time, and presentation/access is indicated by inherited_current.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation linking attention to the same content's organization/presentation/access is stated.

C.rationale: The report lists explicit content items (cell coordinates) with attributes (red/blue).

D.rationale: Origins (kinds) are given separately from the listed content, distinguishing content identity from status/provenance.

O.rationale: The text encodes how contents are presented / accessed (current, candidate, inherited_current, copied_prior_record).
